slug: 2026-01-23 Zambia begins amending Electronic Government Act

facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that the Electronic Government (Amendment) Bill, revising the Electronic Government Act No. 41 of 2021, was presented at a SMART Zambia Institute stakeholder meeting in January 2026 (a bill, not in force); the article describes its content as legal standing for electronic submissions and digital authentication, and ties it to moving from independent digital systems to an integrated ecosystem and to the vendor-locked systems that prevent data sharing, but does not say the bill itself provides for public bodies exchanging data; the date is the article's published date.

note: The article does not say the Act in force provides for public bodies exchanging data, so no in-force fact; the bill fact is borderline on the data-sharing content.

systems.system: National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI) Policy and NSDI Portal
systems.owner: Cabinet Office / Government Chief Technology Officer (Smart Zambia)

note: Story on a spatial data policy and portal launched June 2026 and a Cabinet direction to adopt open-source; it names no law, decree, regulation or draft on public bodies sharing data.

facts.fact: The Electronic Government Act, 2021 (Act No. 41 of 2021, an act of Parliament, assented 19 May 2021) is an enacted e-government law whose own text provides for public bodies sharing data: s.12(3) lets a public body retrieve documents from the issuing public body with the data subject's consent, and s.17 provides for joint automated procedures between public bodies.

The Electronic Government Act, 2021 (Act No. 41 of 2021) only permits sharing between public bodies: s.12(3) says a public body 'may' retrieve documents from another public body with consent, and s.17(1) says it 'may' implement joint automated procedures; neither obliges exchange or connection, and no regulation made under it is mentioned.
